d.title: Bungou Stray Dogs: Hitori Ayumu
d.jp: 文豪ストレイドッグス『独り歩む』
d.synopsis: Armed Detective Agency members discuss the most suitable candidate for the second-in-command. Doppo Kunikida is carrying out official errands as planned in his diary as usual. Unexpectedly, a bomb-related incident occurs, challenging the ideals he has always upheld. When weighing one life over hundreds, how will he proceed?
